name: Wound
description: A blow's damage: armour subtracts unless it pierces; a single wound of half the hit points or more is a major wound.

on_apply.amount: max(0, condition.amount - (if condition.pierce > 0 then 0 else self.armour))

on_apply.when: condition.amount - (if condition.pierce > 0 then 0 else self.armour) >= self.major_wound
